import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction amount distribution by type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
data.boxplot(column='amount', by='transaction_type', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax1.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.sca(ax1)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# 2. Transaction count by type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
transaction_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(transaction_counts))
ax2.bar(transaction_counts.index, transaction_counts.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Count by Type')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Transaction amount by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax3.scatter(data['hour_of_day'], data['amount'], 
                     c=data['transaction_type'].astype('category').cat.codes,
                     s=100, alpha=0.6, cmap='viridis')
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax3.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add legend for transaction types
handles = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', 
                      markerfacecolor=plt.cm.viridis(i/2), 
                      markersize=8, label=t) 
          for i, t in enumerate(data['transaction_type'].unique())]
ax3.legend(handles=handles, title='Transaction Type')

# 4. Fraud status distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
fraud_counts = data['is_fraud'].value_counts()
labels = ['Not Fraud', 'Fraud']
colors_pie = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']
ax4.pie(fraud_counts.values, labels=[labels[i] for i in fraud_counts.index], 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Fraud vs Non-Fraud Transactions')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
